title: Memex Agentic Memory Graph Maintenance Loop
constraints: Start with dry-run previews and explicit validation gates
Promote safety rules into executable DAG nodes, not prose-only constraints
Preserve user data surfaces: do not mutate vaults, trackers, or remote systems until dry-run plans pass
Emit machine-readable artifacts agents can resume
Every high-risk write, sync, or release node must declare observable acceptance criteria
Memory writes require baseline, deduplication, topology delta, scoped sync, and post-sync verification

nodes.title: Start with scored recall packet
nodes.content: Retrieve task-specific memex cards with compact results, then read only necessary leaf cards.
acceptanceCriteria: Recall output is compact and records slugs read

nodes.title: Capture graph health and dirty-state baseline
nodes.content: Run doctor/topology/dirty-state checks before any new card creation.
acceptanceCriteria: Baseline includes orphan, broken-link, hub-degree, dirty-state, and staged-file metrics

nodes.title: Observe session decisions and gotchas
nodes.content: Identify durable insights from actual work: architecture decisions, root causes, conventions, and repeated mistakes.

nodes.title: Check duplicates and contradictions before writing
nodes.content: Compare candidate memories against existing cards for duplicate, contradiction, and better-home matches.

nodes.title: Preview atomic linked cards
nodes.content: Draft one-insight-per-card content and links without syncing or committing.
acceptanceCriteria: Each card has semantic-spine or canonical-hub link

nodes.title: Write atomic linked cards
nodes.content: Use memex_retro for approved one-insight cards; link through semantic spines or canonical hubs rather than direct index sprawl.
acceptanceCriteria: Every written card slug is recorded
No card is written without approved dry-run preview and dedup decision

nodes.title: Repair topology and unresolved aliases
nodes.content: Run scoped organize/doctor/topology scripts; create routing hubs for repeated unresolved concepts, but avoid maintenance-card PageRank bloat.

nodes.title: Validate topology delta and scoped files before sync
nodes.content: Check that topology did not worsen unexpectedly and no derived embeddings/generated caches are staged.

nodes.title: Sync only approved card/report files
nodes.content: Sync scoped card/report files and avoid derived cache artifacts.
acceptanceCriteria: Only approved card/report files are synced
Derived embeddings and generated caches are excluded

nodes.title: Verify graph health after sync
nodes.content: Re-run doctor/topology and compare against baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Post-sync metrics and sync result are recorded

nodes.title: Generate next-session wakeup brief from validated artifacts
nodes.content: Emit compact AAAK-style context: decisions, gotchas, open loops, relevant card slugs, topology delta, and unresolved issues.

edges.description: memory writes are judged against a before-state baseline
new cards require duplicate and contradiction decisions
wakeups summarize validated graph state, not intentions
